subject: Marketplace integration triage: entitlement grid & rollout windows
messages:
From: Kamal Reddy <kamal@bluepeak.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BluePeak marketplace listing: entitlement matrix & timeline

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is the entitlement spec we use for Marketplace listings (bluepeak-entitlement-specs.xlsx). High level asks:

- We need a clear mapping to Redwood entitlements so we can show the correct SKU/tiers in the marketplace listing.
- Support for trial entitlements (14-day sandbox) behind a gated API key.
- A canary rollout window of ~2 weeks before GA so our sales team can validate billing.

We are under a tight date for our channel kickoff (targeting Nov 6). Can Redwood draft a prioritized action grid (must-have vs nice-to-have) and confirm any platform exceptions required (entitlement flags, sandbox isolation, or nonstandard billing hooks)?

Attachments: bluepeak-entitlement-specs.xlsx (xlsx)

Happy to jump on a short triage call — propose Sep 20 PST.

Thanks,
Kamal Reddy
Product Partnerships, BluePeak Systems
kamal@bluepeak.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Kamal Reddy <kamal@bluepeak.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace listing: entitlement matrix & timeline

Kamal —

Received the entitlement spec, thanks. We're going to run an internal triage to surface product/infra asks and any exception items that would block a Nov 6 marketplace listing. Initial notes:

1) Entitlement mapping: we can map BluePeak SKUs to Redwood "dedicated" vs "hosted API" entitlements but need a small schema change for the trial/sandbox token type.
2) Sandbox isolation: this is flagged as an exception in our standard marketplace flow because your trial requires a persistent sandbox with isolated KV-store for 14 days.
3) Billing hooks: marketplace fees + pass-through billing are OK but finance needs the exact line items for revenue recognition.

Next steps from Redwood side (I'll coordinate):
- Product (karthik): confirm schema change scope and ETA.
- Runtime/infra (aditya): validate sandbox isolation feasibility and cost estimate.
- Sales (ben): confirm commercial implications and whether we need a marketplace discount schedule.

Kamal — can you share a prioritized must-have / nice-to-have list and any legal constraints (e.g., data residency, special logging) before our triage call? I'll set a 30-min slot for Sep 20 PST.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace), Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace listing: entitlement matrix & timeline

Neha / team —

Quick technical triage after reviewing the spec:

- Schema change: small; add a 'trial_type' enum (none, timeboxed_sandbox, promo_code). Should be safe; I estimate a 3–5 day work effort for API + console surfaces.
- Sandbox isolation: this is the sticky bit. We can provide timeboxed sandbox tokens, but persistent per-customer KV isolation for 14 days needs either dedicated namespaces per account or short-lived namespaces + state export. Dedicated namespaces will require a small infra exception because our standard marketplace sandbox reuses a shared ephemeral namespace.
- Rollout window: operationally we should do a 2-week canary with telemetry (errors, latency by region, token churn). Suggest Oct 16–29 for canary, GA Nov 6 is doable if the sandbox exception is approved this week.

Action items for us:
- I'll draft the API change PR and console mockups (ETA Sep 25).
- Aditya to confirm infra implication and cost delta.
- Ben to align on whether sales wants the trial to show as a separate SKU in the marketplace (affects entitlement mapping).

Also attaching a quick CSV draft for the mapping table I'll use to review internally.

Attachments: redwood-entitlement-mapping-draft.csv

—Karthik
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace listing: entitlement matrix & timeline

Team —

Commercial considerations to flag for the triage:

- Marketplace placement: BluePeak wants the trial visible to self-serve leads; if we show trial as a standalone SKU we'll need tagging so finance can match marketplace invoices to trials. Finance has asked for the marketplace fee schedule by Oct 1.
- Discounting: BluePeak asked informally about a co-marketing/transaction fee carve; we should have legal/finance review before committing.
- Deal stager: we should capture the HubSpot deal ID (BP-2028-0142) so CSM and renewals have attribution.

Please add legal/finance to the triage invite. I can host the meeting notes in HubSpot and keep track of the rollout calendar. Proposed meeting: Sep 20 10:00–10:30 PST (I blocked a half hour).

Ben Carter
Sales, Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: marketplace-rollout-calendar.ics

From: Kamal Reddy <kamal@bluepeak.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak marketplace listing: entitlement matrix & timeline

Neha / team —

Thanks for the quick triage. We can accept the proposed Oct 16 canary -> Nov 6 GA plan provided the sandbox isolation exception is approved (BluePeak legal is OK with our standard logging/retention). I've attached a short priority list (must-have = trial sandbox, entitlement mapping, billing hooks; nice-to-have = console labels, promotional codes).

Confirming availability for Sep 20 10:00 PST. I'll invite our legal lead for a 10-minute slot at the end to sign off on logging/retention language.

Thanks,
Kamal
Product Partnerships, BluePeak Systems
Attachments: bluepeak-priorities-v1.pdf (PDF)
